done.why: I saw the self-confrontation scene and stopped after a short session.

about: A cave-adventure test of worthiness. You explore passages with a lantern and fight a shadow double of yourself.

ending.what: None. The final test and the silver-haired man were never found.

moments.note: The first reply said 'You can't take the lamp' when I typed 'lantern'. Naming was inconsistent.
Entering the Land of Shadow made the sword leap into my hand and a hooded double appear.
Taking the hood showed my own face, which then faded. It was a good reveal.

wished: To talk to the hooded figure before the fight.
To pull the sword from the rock myself.

lines.line: you recoil in horror at the sight of your own face, weary and wounded.
lines.why: This is the strongest moment in the session.

fun.why: The fight and reveal were good. The parser was a little stiff.

engagement.why: A short session with a clear hook.

difficulty.why: The fight ended after two hits.

interestingness.why: The sword that appears when you enter the room, and the self-duel, were both unexpected.

prose.why: The writing was functional, with a few evocative lines.
